_help: Fill this in during setup (see SETUP.md step 4). The scripts and the HQ page read it. No secrets here: the token lives only in the environment.

business.name: YOUR BUSINESS NAME
business.stack: e.g. Lovable pages, GoHighLevel CRM + SMS, Stripe, Supabase

face.name: OWNER FULL NAME
face._help: Shown next to the headshot on tweet-style ads.

_adsPathHelp: ghl | meta-cli | both. ghl = build + publish through GoHighLevel Ad Manager (needs the GHL token + location ID). meta-cli = Graph API with a Meta system-user token. Pick in setup step 3.

ghl._help: GHL sub-account (location) ID: Settings → Business Profile, or the URL after /location/. Not a secret. The Private Integration Token is a network secret for services.leadconnectorhq.com, never in a file.

result._help: What one result is, and which Meta event counts it. metaAction is one of: lead, complete_registration, contact, schedule, submit_application, omni_purchase, onsite_conversion.messaging_conversation_started_7d. Set offline to true if the real count comes from your CRM/Stripe (fill client/results.json) instead of the pixel.
result.name: leads

economics._help: Value of one customer, breakeven cost per result, target cost per result. These set the tiers.

tiers._help: 7-day cost per result. Below scaleBelow = scale; up to holdUpTo = hold; up to lowerUpTo = lower budget; above = kill. Leave 0 until the economics are known.

budget._prefixHelp: Optional name prefix for the agent campaigns (e.g. [Claude]). Empty = none; the agent tracks its campaigns by id in agentCampaigns.

offers._help: One row per offer. match = a piece of the landing page URL (regex) that identifies it.
offers.name: Main offer

design._help: Ad colors for ops/newads/render-statics.js: dark ground + one accent, from the brand (client/business/design.md).
